reason: I already pay every month for a tracker that works, and I don't have proof this camera-and-GPS thing stays on his wrist or that the SOS connects when I need it at 2 a.m. I'd be the one rebuilding his routine around a new device, and I've got no time to be a guinea pig for a 30-day test.
objection: They will just pull it off or refuse to wear it, and I'll be paying $25 a month for a camera that sits in a drawer while he's out the door.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on a kid like mine showing the locking harness holds through a real struggle, plus proof the SOS connects on a bad signal and the video call works from my phone.
